Data Analyst (Entry Level)
Halcyon Retail Group | Hybrid — Pune

The Analytics team turns transaction and inventory data into decisions about
what we stock and where. You will sit with the merchandising team and answer
their questions with data.

Key responsibilities
- Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau or Power BI
- Write SQL queries against our Snowflake warehouse
- Produce weekly reporting on sales performance and stock movement
- Clean and validate data from point-of-sale and supplier systems
- Present findings to non-technical stakeholders

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Business or similar
- Strong SQL — you must be able to write joins, window functions and CTEs
- Advanced Excel including pivot tables and lookup functions
- Demonstrated ability to communicate findings clearly in writing
- Attention to detail

Preferred
- Python for data analysis, particularly pandas
- Experience with a BI tool such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker
- Exposure to dbt or another transformation framework
- Retail or e-commerce domain knowledge
